cells:
  data
    out:    orders: List<Order>, regions: string[], rng: Random
    uses types
  threshold
    out:    threshold: Slider
  summary
    in:     orders: List<Order> <- data, threshold: Slider <- threshold
    out:    big: List<Order>
    uses types
edges:
  data -> types
  summary -> data [orders]
  summary -> threshold [threshold]
  summary -> types
downstream:
  data: summary
  threshold: summary
  summary: 
  types: data, summary
